# Within-group input versus projected Flow interpolation

Run: `/home/d3vd5k/Projects/ml_project_2/results/runs/20261009T184911-73fbcd66cdde`
Independent verification: **passed**, 1019888 checks.
Five matched seeds, native logistic regression/random forest/LightGBM, Shoppers only.

## Design
The matched primary contrast is Flow minus within-group input. Both start with identical canonical U2 native prefixes, U2 groups, quotas, same-class same-group distinct real parents, nearest-input neighbor options, NumPy partner/lambda streams and K=5. Later trajectories may diverge after actual native refits.
Flow uses z=(1−λ)f(real_i)+λf(real_j), followed by f⁻¹(z) for numeric coordinates. Detector numeric scaler inversion bridges to the original classifier preprocessor. Original partner categories are copied; discrete columns do NOT follow an exact invertible path. This is mixed-data projected latent interpolation, not a label guarantee.
The real-parent cache uses existing deterministic content-keyed full-onehot uniform dequantization once per seed/role, shared across both branches and all classifiers. No new Flow training or parent-forward per round. Original real-only inner-fit auto/CUDA checkpoint remains frozen; smoke uses a fresh frozen development checkpoint.
Unknown/unrepresentable parents are ineligible in BOTH matched branches. Nonfinite/out-of-intrinsic-domain candidates are invalid BEFORE baseline nearest-neighbor relocation, with no repair, rounding, clipping or observed min/max enforcement. All ten Shoppers numeric fields are nonnegative; BounceRates, ExitRates and SpecialDay also ≤1; counts stay continuous.
The original class-wide RealSupport neighbor graph and native relocation reference set remain unchanged. The legacy support_summary.group_support.partner_scope describes that baseline support table, not the new proposer. Actual within-group generation scope is recorded in geometry.parents and independently checked parent_group_ids/partner_group_ids.
Baseline relocation is retained on valid candidates only. Reported accepted points are AFTER relocation; real-match/relocation diagnostics explicitly quantify how relocation can erase nonlinear geometry.
Target 1000, maximum 20 rounds; quotas/cadence/stopping remain original plain random. Actual final counts—not an equal-dose assumption—are reported. No F1 rejection, tau tuning, label gate, guidance, utility, influence, surrogate or automatic retention.
Retained U5+F1 is unchanged; pool-utility is discarded; historical pool-random+F1 and the new Flow geometry remain pending. Historical references retain source-run/record/artifact provenance and are not directly timing-comparable. Only fresh geometry phase timings are compared.
One shared fixed outer holdout; five matched seeds are NOT independent folds. Mean ± sample SD (ddof=1); all24 numeric fields include descriptive counts/threshold/ROC diagnostics as well as performance. No significance claim.

## Interpretation — retention remains pending

- **No universal improvement.** Relative to the matched within-group input control, Flow improves tree-model AP and ordinary cross-entropy, but lowers minority recall at the fixed 0.5 threshold and worsens balanced cross-entropy and configured error cost. Logistic Regression loses AP, minority F1 and MCC. Full values and paired sample standard deviations follow below.
- **Geometry is genuinely exercised, but validity is a substantial limitation.** 62.2% of outer Flow proposals are ineligible; decoded negatives are overwhelmingly larger than numerical-rounding scale. No invalid coordinate is rescued by relocation. Of accepted outer Flow points, 91.5% are unrelocated nonreal coordinates; the remaining 8.5% match real points after baseline relocation.
- **Counts are close, not exactly matched.** Within-group input accepts 1000 per seed/classifier. Flow accepts 993–999 for LR, 999–1000 for RF and 998–1000 for LightGBM. This is not a pure equal-dose comparison; the existing stopping/quotas are deliberately not overridden.
- **Compute is not free despite reusing the Flow.** Shared parent caching and inverse inference are small; extra native refitting dominates. RF fresh outer trajectory time rises from about 33.37 to 56.88 seconds on average. Historical runtime values are provenance only, not a like-for-like speed comparison.

U5+F1 stays retained. This experiment does not retain Flow geometry or freeze Phase 1; the user decides whether the mixed benefits justify it.

## Verification and reproduction

The actual three-native-classifier development smoke passed, followed by all 268 tests / 307 subtests. The full scientific command completed in 1039.26 seconds of observed shell time; the recorded pipeline timer is 1037.031 seconds. Independent replay passed 1,019,888 checks with zero failures, including 490 prefix refits and 502 learned-model/prediction comparisons. Timings are accounted for, not independently reproduced. The benchmark contains 150 records, including 120 outer records for all eight final methods and 30 fresh inner geometry trajectories.

[All per-field metric summaries](../results/runs/20261009T184911-73fbcd66cdde/full_field_metric_summary.csv), [every paired seed difference](../results/runs/20261009T184911-73fbcd66cdde/full_field_paired_seed_deltas.csv), [coverage and quota diagnostics](../results/runs/20261009T184911-73fbcd66cdde/group_count_coverage_diagnostics.csv), [matched resource differences](../results/runs/20261009T184911-73fbcd66cdde/new_trajectory_resource_paired.csv), and [the independent proof](../results/runs/20261009T184911-73fbcd66cdde/independent_verification.json) are preserved alongside the other supplemental CSVs listed above.

Historical references come through `results/runs/20261009T170013-d5be50bc2107`; original UGO/U2/U5/U5+F1 artifacts preserve their earlier `20261009T153348-af844bdecf5a` provenance. No historical classifier search or frozen Flow training was repeated for the scientific geometry run. Initial matched checkpoints/parents/coefficients agree; after refitting, the two iterative trajectories can diverge.
